details.description: Mistral 7B v0.2 is the 7.24-billion-parameter, Apache 2.0-licensed pretrained base checkpoint that Mistral AI used to train Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, with a roughly 32.7k-token context window per its Fireworks AI hosting page. As a base model it has no instruction-tuning or built-in moderation and is meant as a foundation for fine-tuning rather than direct chat use. Mistral AI's own mistralai-org repository for this checkpoint is gated; the public copy commonly used today is a community re-upload (mistral-community/Mistral-7B-v0.2) converted from Mistral's original CDN weights. On Mistral AI's own hosted API, the Mistral 7B family (API name open-mistral-7b) has been deprecated since 2024-11-30 and retired since 2025-03-30.
advantages: Extends the base Mistral 7B's context window to roughly 32.7k tokens, per Fireworks AI's model page.
Apache 2.0 licensed, permitting commercial and research use, per the Hugging Face community model card.
disadvantages: Pretrained base model only, not instruction-tuned; not intended for direct chat use without fine-tuning.

The official mistralai-org Hugging Face repository for this checkpoint is gated; the widely used public copy is a community re-upload that itself warns it 'might not be up-to-date' (mistral-community/Mistral-7B-v0.2).
Mistral AI deprecated the Mistral 7B family (API name open-mistral-7b) on its own hosted platform on 2024-11-30 and retired it on 2025-03-30.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for further pretraining or fine-tuning into instruction-following or task-specific models.
Foundation used by Mistral AI to train the Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 chat model.

notes: Mistral AI's official mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.2 Hugging Face repo returned HTTP 401 (gated) when fetched, so its content could not be read directly; the description relies instead on the Fireworks AI hosting page and the mistral-community re-upload. Catalog's max_input/output_tokens (32768) match the ~32.7k figure Fireworks gives. Mistral AI's own model-status page marks the whole Mistral 7B family (v0.1/v0.2/v0.3, API name open-mistral-7b) as deprecated 2024-11-30 and retired 2025-03-30 on its hosted API; the catalog carries no deprecation_date for this entry. No exact-model numeric benchmark for v0.2 itself was found (only v0.1-specific claims), so evaluations is left empty rather than reuse a different version's numbers. The 'no built-in moderation' claim is not stated on v0.2's own (gated) card; added the public mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 card, which carries Mistral's standard base-model boilerplate ('is a pretrained base model and therefore does not have any moderation mechanisms'), as support since v0.2 is the same base-model family under that unchanged card template.
